utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. Is it tonight, and was the title The Secret Garden?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not tonight — we were thinking next Thursday at my place, and I’ll send the reminder tomorrow. I’m not sure it was The Secret Garden, so let’s confirm the title too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — next Thursday at your place, and thanks for the reminder. I’ll keep an eye out for the title confirmation too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect—thanks, Opal. A cozy, discussion-friendly pick would be lovely, and I’m happy to vote on a few options.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep the list moving and narrow it to a few cozy, discussion-friendly options. Once we’ve got votes, we can pick a spot for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Opal—thanks for keeping it moving. I’m looking forward to voting and seeing what cozy pick we land on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I still think 7:00 PM at my place this Thursday makes the most sense, but I’m happy to confirm it for everyone so there’s no confusion.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—can you also remind me which mystery book we picked?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — we picked the mystery novel by the window, and I’ll send everyone a clear reminder about 7:00 PM at my place this Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m still checking the book title, so once that’s confirmed we’ll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, we’re reading "The Secret Garden" this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — The Secret Garden is the one. I’ll pass that along and we’re all set for next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ve already got the extra chairs, tea, cookies, and fruit covered. We should be all set for book club snacks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm — are we definitely doing book club this Thursday evening, and is it still at my place? I want to make sure everyone has the right details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — Thursday evening at your place still works, and I’ll make sure everyone has the details. We’re all set on chairs, tea, and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly Mara, June, and old Mr. Vale have been the steady ones lately. A few others drift in and out, but that little trio’s been the regular core.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a solid little core — I’ll check what they picked next and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I’d love to hear what they picked — Mara usually has opinions, of course.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check my calendar and send a couple of times after 3:30 that won’t conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — after 3:30 works for me too, and I’ll keep an eye out for your times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll send a couple of options soon, and I’ll also confirm whether we’re still meeting at the library.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia—what’s the plan for the next meeting, and are we still reading The Secret Garden?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, we’re still reading The Secret Garden, and Thursday at 7 at Quinn’s place still works for me. I can bring a drink—just let me know if you want anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:45 works for me, and a simple snack is fine. Thanks, Pia—I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — The Thursday Murder Club. Thanks for keeping me on track; I’ll try not to forget it again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right, that’s the one. I’m still a bit scattered today, but I should be there tonight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, I’m scattered too — see you tonight, and we’ll both pretend we remembered on purpose.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — I’d love to hear what the book club’s reading next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’d love a quick recap of what the group’s been reading next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the next pick yet, just that I’m curious to find out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'll keep an eye out for Faye’s options.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back from Faye. See you Thursday at 7!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — could you confirm the title for me? I want to make sure we’ve got the right book for book club.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — we’re still confirming the title, but the meeting has moved to Thursday at the cafe. I’ll send the final book once the group settles on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — Thursday at the cafe works for me. Please send the final book title when it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, Sam — we’re reading "The Secret Garden," and I’ll have the book club stuff ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — that sounds right. I’ll go with "The Secret Garden" and double-check if needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just bring yourself, and I’ll handle the book club stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the book club actually happening this Thursday, and if so, where is it? I’d rather not assume and tell everyone the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still set for Thursday, and I’m keeping the location list handy—I’ll confirm the spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the exact place and time once you have it? I’d rather tell everyone the right details than guess.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—could you confirm it’s "The Night Circus" for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s "The Night Circus" for book club. I’ll send a quick update so everyone has the right details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll let the group know too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds great, Leo — I’m still happy with "The Thursday Murder Club" for this month, and I’d love to hear any cozy options you think might work next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send a couple cozy options next.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll look out for them and we can pick one together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great—thanks! I’ll keep an eye out for Faye’s options.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Pia — I’ll let you know if I think of anything. For now, just the usual catch-up is perfect!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll send the title as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate you checking — I’ll look for your message.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the day, time, and whether we’re meeting at the library before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush — just let me know when you’ve confirmed the day, time, and library.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll confirm the day, time, and library, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send a couple of times after 3:30, and I’ll confirm the library details once I check my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ve got the chairs, tea, cookies, and fruit covered for book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect, thanks — I’ll send those times soon and confirm the library details too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly Mara, June, and old Mr. Vale have been the regulars lately — that little trio’s been the steadiest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a lovely steady group. Let’s build around them and pick something cozy that everyone’s finished, then I can put out a quick vote.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word to Mara, June, and Mr. Vale, and see if anyone else wants to chime in too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking the mystery novel title, and I’ll tell you as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you checking. I’m still trying to keep it straight, but I think it’s The Thursday Murder Club.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds right to me — I’ll double-check it and let Mina know once I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s next Thursday at 7 at my place, and we’re reading "The Night Circus."

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that sounds great. I’ll plan on next Thursday at 7 and start reading "The Night Circus".

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome — looking forward to seeing you then!
